2. **lighthouse-core/gather/gather-runner.js**: This file is involved in setting up the driver and running the tests. It includes the `setupDriver` method, which calls `getUserAgent` to set the user agent in the base artifacts. Any discrepancies in how the user agent is set or used during the test runs could lead to the observed mismatch.
